description: D2 negative doc/settings probes: code-logic queries where doc/config files MUST NOT outrank impl. Targets high-doc-density repos (rust 413 md, javascript 158 md, csharp 88 md, lua 66 html, kotlin 60 md, python 39 md) plus standard repos. Each probe asks about CODE behavior; the gold is a code file. PASS means demotion correctly kept docs/yml/html below code; FAIL likely means a doc outranked code (demotion failure). Per PLAN §5 D2: measurement-only; no chunker/demotion changes.

probes.notes: Negative doc probe: 'format' + 'configuration' present in many docs but code is in ruff_python_formatter crate
